stories.title: Delsol asks council to rule overnight lorry movements at Sandycroft depot are lawful
stories.summary: A Sandycroft delivery firm has asked Flintshire County Council to rule that night-time lorry movements at its depot are lawful, despite a planning condition banning operations between midnight and 6.30am. stories.title: Cheshire Police among seven forces inspected over facial recognition searches
stories.summary: Police forces are searching custody photographs that should have been deleted when they use facial recognition to identify suspects, a national inspection has found. stories.title: Connah’s Quay’s Andy Dunbobbin elected chair of Police Digital Service board
stories.summary: North Wales Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin, from Connah’s Quay, has been elected chair of the board of the Police Digital Service. stories.title: “Extreme recklessness”: Flintshire councillors face vote to condemn their own colleagues
stories.summary: Flintshire councillors will be asked to condemn colleagues who changed the council’s call-in rules last month, in a motion claiming the new process is incompatible with the law.
